arxiv-1512-08460.title: A polynomial action for gravity with matter, gauge-fixing and ghosts
arxiv-1512-08460.creator: Igor Khavkine
arxiv-1512-08460.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by Igor Khavkine. We give a variational formulation of General Relativity, with coupling to a cosmological constant, to scalar fields, to vector fields and to spinor fields (all with possible mass and interaction terms). Among the matter fields, we include ghosts corresponding to diffeomorphism and Yang-Mills gauge symmetries, with kinetic terms given by gauge fixing conditions leading to hyperbolic equations of motion for all fields.

arxiv-2106-12124.title: Secure Domain Adaptation with Multiple Sources
arxiv-2106-12124.creator: Serban Stan sstan@usc.edu, Mohammad Rostami rostamim@usc.edu
arxiv-2106-12124.description: Abstract Multi-source unsupervised domain adaptation (MUDA) is a framework to address the challenge of annotated data scarcity in a target domain via transferring knowledge from multiple annotated source domains. When the source domains are distributed, data privacy and security can become significant concerns and protocols may limit data sharing, yet existing MUDA methods overlook these constraints.

arxiv-2112-10374.title: CGIBNet: Bandwidth-constrained Communication with Graph Information Bottleneck in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2112-10374.creator: Qi Tian, Kun Kuang, Baoxiang Wang, Furui Liu, Fei Wu
arxiv-2112-10374.description: Abstract Communication is one of the core components for cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). The communication bandwidth, in many real applications, is always subject to certain constraints. To improve communication efficiency, in this article, we propose to simultaneously optimize whom to communicate with and what to communicate for each agent in MARL.

arxiv-2301-11304.title: Gravitoelectromagnetic quadrirefringence
arxiv-2301-11304.creator: Antonio Enea Romano 1 , Sergio A. Vallejo-Peña 1
arxiv-2301-11304.description: Abstract We develop an effective approach for the study of the interaction of gravitational waves (GW) and electromagnetic waves (EMW), showing that quadrirefringence can be produced, a phenomenon consisting in a frequency and polarization dependency of the speed of GWs and EMWs.

arxiv-2302-14296.title: Discrete-time Optimal Covariance Steering via Semidefinite Programming
arxiv-2302-14296.creator: George Rapakoulias, Panagiotis Tsiotras
arxiv-2302-14296.description: Abstract This paper addresses the optimal covariance steering problem for stochastic discrete-time linear systems subject to probabilistic state and control constraints. A method is presented to efficiently attain the exact solution of the problem based on a lossless convex relaxation of the original non-linear program using semidefinite programming.

arxiv-2304-12894.title: An evolutionary model for the V404 Cyg system
arxiv-2304-12894.creator: L. Bartolomeo Koninckx 1,2, M. A. De Vito 1,2, O. G. Benvenuto 1,2
arxiv-2304-12894.description: Abstract V404 Cyg is a low mass X-Ray binary (LMXB) system that has undergone outbursts in 1938, 1989, and 2015. During these events, it has been possible to make determinations for the relevant data of the system. This data include the mass of the compact object (i.e.

arxiv-2310-19513.title: Inverse folding for antibody sequence design using deep learning
arxiv-2310-19513.creator: Frédéric A. Dreyer, Daniel Cutting, Constantin Schneider, Henry Kenlay, Charlotte M. Deane
arxiv-2310-19513.description: Abstract We consider the problem of antibody sequence design given 3D structural information. Building on previous work, we propose a fine-tuned inverse folding model that is specifically optimised for antibody structures and outperforms generic protein models on sequence recovery and structure robustness when applied on antibodies, with notable improvement on the hypervariable CDR-H3 loop.

arxiv-2402-11865.title: Entanglement Measure Based on Optimal Entanglement Witness
arxiv-2402-11865.creator: Nan Yang 1 , Jiaji Wu 1 , Xianyun Dong 1 , Longyu Xiao 1 , Jing Wang 1 , Ming Li 1
arxiv-2402-11865.description: Abstract We introduce a new entanglement measure based on optimal entanglement witness. First of all, we show that the entanglement measure satisfies some necessary properties, including zero entanglements for all separable states, convexity, continuity, invariance under local unitary operations and non-increase under local operations and classical communication(LOCC).

arxiv-2407-12357.title: Evaluating graph-based explanations for AI-based recommender systems
arxiv-2407-12357.creator: Simon Delarue, Astrid Bertrand, Tiphaine Viard
arxiv-2407-12357.description: Abstract . Recent years have witnessed a rapid growth of recommender systems, providing suggestions in numerous applications with potentially high social impact, such as health or justice. Meanwhile, in Europe, the upcoming AI Act mentions transparency as a requirement for critical AI systems in order to “mitigate the risks to fundamental rights”.

arxiv-2504-06008.title: Impact of newly measured β \beta -delayed neutron emitters around Ni 78 {}^{78}\mathrm{Ni} on light element nucleosynthesis in the neutrino-wind following a neutron star merger
arxiv-2504-06008.creator: A. Tolosa-Delgado, J. L. Tain, M. Reichert, A. Arcones, M. Eichler, B. C. Rasco, N. T. Brewer, K.P. Rykaczewski, R. Yokoyama, R. Grzywacz, I. Dillmann, J. Agramunt, D. S. Ahn, A. Algora, H. Baba, S. Bae, C. G. Bruno, R. Caballero Folch, F. Calvino, P. J. Coleman-Smith, G. Cortes, T. Davinson, C. Dom
arxiv-2504-06008.description: Abstract Neutron emission probabilities and half-lives of 37 β \beta -delayed neutron emitters from Ni 75 {}^{75}\mathrm{Ni} to Br 92 {}^{92}\mathrm{Br} were measured at the RIKEN Nishina Center in Japan, including 11 one-neutron and 13 two-neutron emission probabilities and 6 half-lives for the first time that supersede theoretical estimates.

arxiv-2508-12838.title: Quantum nature of gravity in self-bound quantum droplets
arxiv-2508-12838.creator: Asma Tahar Taiba 1 and Abdelâali Boudjemâa 2,3
arxiv-2508-12838.description: Abstract We explore the possibility of testing the quantum nature of the gravitational field with an ultracold self-bound quantum droplet of one-dimensional Bose-Bose mixtures. To this end, we solve variationally and numerically the underlying generalized Gross-Pitaevskii equation which includes the effects of quadratic and cubic nonlinearities. We derive the associated generalized uncertainty principle and its corresponding minimal length.

pmc-10985744.title: Inflammatory bowel diseases and the clinical course of coronavirus disease 2019 – a Polish single-centre experience from the pre-vaccine era
pmc-10985744.creator: Estera Banasik, Agnieszka Dobrowolska, Barbara Kołodziejczak, Piotr Eder
pmc-10985744.description: IntroductionThe data on the relationship between inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) and the course of COVID-19 from East-Central Europe are scarce.AimTo assess the frequency of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection in IBD patients and the impact of IBD on the COVID-19 course from the perspective of a Polish tertiary centre.

pmc-11365572.title: Traumatic Brain Injury Patients Admitted on High-Census Days Receive Less Critical Care and Have an Increased Risk for Delirium
pmc-11365572.creator: David R Velez, Anthony J Duncan, Khaled Zreik
pmc-11365572.description: Introduction: The utilization of healthcare services in a growing population has raised concerns about its impact on clinical outcomes. Studies have shown that increased hospital census is associated with higher admission rates and unnecessary consults, tests, and procedures in various areas of healthcare.

pmc-11481140.title: Association of regular plasmapheresis donation with serum protein and electrolyte levels: a multicentre cross-sectional study in China
pmc-11481140.creator: Guanglin Xiao, Changqing Li, Yongjun Chen, Wenfu Song, Hui Yang, Yating Yang, Yu Zhang, Zhongping Pu, Xiufang Wang, Shina Xie, Shouqiang Yang, Jun Zeng, Wan Li, Ya Wang
pmc-11481140.description: AbstractBackgroundChina’s plasmapheresis donation policy differs from that of Western countries. The association between regular plasmapheresis donation and donor health in China is still unknown.ObjectivesTo investigate the association of regular plasmapheresis donation with serum protein and electrolyte levels and provide scientific evidence for policy improvement.DesignMulticentre cross-sectional study.

pmc-11509820.title: Automatic High-Resolution Operational Modal Identification of Thin-Walled Structures Supported by High-Frequency Optical Dynamic Measurements
pmc-11509820.creator: Tongfa Deng, Yuexin Wang, Jinwen Huang, Maosen Cao, Dragoslav Sumarac
pmc-11509820.description: High-frequency optical dynamic measurement can realize multiple measurement points covering the whole surface of the thin-walled structure, which is very useful for obtaining high-resolution spatial information for damage localization. However, the noise and low calculation efficiency seriously hinder its application to real-time, online structural health monitoring.

pmc-12522994.title: Organic fertilizers increase microbial community diversity and stability slowing down the transformation process of nutrient cycling
pmc-12522994.creator: Xueli Chen, Xingzhu Ma, Zhuxiu Liu, Haidong Gu, Hairui Fang, Zongzhuan Shen, Huibo Zhang, Shuming Wan, Weiqun Li, Xiaoyu Hao, Nicholas John Clarke, Junjie Liu
pmc-12522994.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundSoil microbes play a central role in nutrient recycling in soils: however, the genetic mechanisms governing their responses to long-term fertilization remain poorly understood. While the agronomic benefits of long-term fertilization are well-documented, the genetic mechanisms and ecological processes underlying microbial community responses to different fertilization regimes remain poorly understood, particularly in unique soil systems such as black soils (Mollisols), which are critical for global food security.

pmc-12606144.title: A novel hybrid model integrating CEEMDAN decomposition, dispersion entropy and LSTM for photovoltaic power forecasting and anomaly detection
pmc-12606144.creator: Ziqi Qiu, Jiarong Ye, Jiahui Lu, Nenghui Zhu
pmc-12606144.description: Photovoltaic (PV) power generation exhibits significant non-stationary characteristics due to the influence of meteorological conditions and equipment status, which makes traditional prediction methods difficult to accurately capture its dynamic variations and abnormal behaviors. To address these limitations, a CEEMDAN-DispEn-LSTM hybrid framework is proposed for PV power forecasting and anomaly detection.

pmc-12622708.title: Genetic causal association between metabolic syndrome and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: A 2-sample Mendelian randomization
pmc-12622708.creator: Qing Liu, Qin Luo, Wei Chen, Xuemei Kuang, Jianmei Wu, Jianhua Tan
pmc-12622708.description: Prior epidemiological investigations have indicated a linkage between metabolic syndrome (MetS) and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). The objective of the present research was to elucidate the inherited causal relationship of MetS with IPF. A 2-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) design was adopted to assess the genetic cause-effect link between MetS and IPF.

pmc-13294490.title: Cross-domain transfer learning strategy enhances interpretability of deep learning model explanations
pmc-13294490.creator: Matteo Zannini, Alexander Hammer, Hagen Malberg, Martin Schmidt

pmc-13456263.title: Assessing scale and predictive diversity in models for single-cell transcriptomics based on Geneformer
pmc-13456263.creator: Junfan Chen, Fabian Schmidt, Ricardo Henao, Michael Domaratzki, Jean Fan, Michael Domaratzki, Jean Fan, Michael Domaratzki, Jean Fan
pmc-13456263.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Single-cell transcriptomic data provide critical insights into cellular states and disease mechanisms, and foundation models have recently emerged as powerful tools for learning gene–gene relationships from these data. However, current approaches often overlook key challenges, including the mismatch between model design and the rank-ordered structure of gene expression profiles, as well as the unclear benefits of large-scale pretraining for biological applications. Here, we present GFCAB, a modified modeling framework designed to better capture the structural properties of ranked single-cell transcriptomic data.

pmc-13555333.title: Effects of Home-Based Antisuppression and Binocular Integration Training in Patients with Intermittent Exotropia: A Retrospective Study
pmc-13555333.creator: Ziqing Ding, Yulian Zhou, Jingrong Liu, Zhi Chen, Chen Zhao, Wen Wen
pmc-13555333.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the association between 6-month home-based antisuppression with binocular integration training with binocular sensory outcomes and the 2-year surgical rate in patients with intermittent exotropia (IXT).MethodsIn this retrospective cohort study, patients diagnosed with IXT were included and classified into training and control groups according to their treatment history.
